tei:div.tei:p: 181) ༄༅/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha'i snyan brgyud kyi gsol ka nyung ngur bsdus pa bzhugs so// 182)༄/

mgon po ma ning ni/ hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po sku mdog nag: dar nag ber chen brjid pa gsol: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa yis: ru mtshon g.yon pas snying zhags 'dzin: gser sked bcings shing bing chen gtsugs: zhabs la sag l+h+wam sngon po gsol: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs: g.yas su srog bdud sku mdog nag: bdud mda' phyir bkang rta 183)nag zhon: g.yon du dpal 'bar sku mdog dmar: ral gri nad rkyal phyag na bsnams: sde brgyad snang srid lha 'dres bskor: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ shri ma hā ka la ga ṇa gu h+ya raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: mdung 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: mgon po mdung 'dzin zhal gcig pa: phyag bzhi khros pa'i cha lugs mdog: mdung dar gnyis 184)dang 'og rdo rje: bhan+dha 'dzin cing rta dang rlung: glog dmar chibs nas 'jig rten nyul: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma hā ka la ma ṇi bir wa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swa hā: brag lha ni/ hūm̐: brag lha mgon po lha de po: sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs: zhag gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ru mtshon: g.yon pa'i lag na thod khrag 'dzin: sku la dar nag phod kha gsol: chibs su rta nag rlung gshog chibs: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma hā ka la du ru hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā: tshogs bdag ni/ hūm̐: jo bo tshogs bdag sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi glang chen dbu: g.yas gnyis nor bu lcags kyu dang: g.yon gnyis zhags pa ne'u le: 185) ne'u le byi ba'i gdan steng du: zhabs gnyis phyed pa'i skyil mos bzhugs: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ga ṇa pa ti ba ra ta ka swa hā: zhal bzhi ni/ hūm̐: gdong bzhi nag po bram ze khros pa'i gzugs: ber nag stag sham gsol zhing gri thod 'dzin:

zhabs gnyis dor stabs mdung dar gra la gzir: mchod cing bstod do gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mi rung sna dgu dmigs pa'i dgra la thongs: dam las ma 'da' myur du phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā: phyag bzhi ni/ hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni rgya gar rdo rje gdan: dud khrod ming ni rab 'jigs bsil ba'i tshal: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas: 186) las kyi mgon po 'jigs byed bya rog gdong: ma gcig lha mo 'bar ma nag mo dang: dpal ldan phrin las mgon po seṅge'i gdong: sha za srin po gtum chen rā hu la: sgrol ging gshin rje btsan dang gnod sbyin tshogs: sngon gyi thugs dam gnyen po brtser dgongs la: mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma hā kā la e ka tsa ti gu ṇa hrī da hūm̐ phaṭa: las mgon srog bdud ni/ mdun du trag shad sku mdog nag: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ru mtshon: g.yon pas snying dang zhags pa 'dzin: ber nag brjid cing gser sked bing: nga ro sgrogs nas rta nag zhon: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma hā kā la trag shad raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ dza: gnod sbyin shan dmar ni: rang gi mdun dbus gnod sbyin ni: sku 187)mdog dmar po me mdog chags: me yi phung po phyogs bcur 'phro: phyag bzhi dang po gnyis kyi ni: gri gug thod khrag 'og ma gnyis: ral gri tsit+ta phyag na 'dzin: sku la ber chen brjid pa gsol: khyung dmar 'jigs pa la bcibs nas: gling bzhi skad cig rtsis la 'debs: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: e he rme ru rtse gu ṇa hrī da hūm̐ phaṭa: sngags srung ni/ mdun du e ka tsa ti sngo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas zhing dbyug: g.yon pas lcags spyang mgo dgu 'dzin: chibs su bong bu smug gwa bcibs:

gzig gi sham thabs smad la dkris: gcer bur bskyed nas spyan drang ngo: mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub 188)par mdzod: oṃ e ka tsa ti bh+yo hring: dud sol ni/ mdun du dpal ldan dud sol ma: zhal gcig phyag ni shin tu 'jigs: sku mdog nag po mi lpags gsol: re lde'i sham thabs smad du dkris: ral pa phyed yar thor cog byas: phyed mar thur shal dang po gnyis: kha ṭ+waṃ' sbrul zhags 'og ma gnyis: ral gri thod khrag 'dzin pa ste: gser sgrog mdzes pas zhabs la brgyan: bong bu dmar gwa 'phongs mig zhon: snga ru phyi ru gnyis po ni: srin thod skam po dgra thod rlon: khrag mtsho 'bog cing rlung tshub dkyil: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ shrī dhe wi kā li bh+yo: zhing skyong seng gdong ni/ snang ba mtha' yas bka' srung ba: bdud pho nag po seng ge'i gdong: nag po zhal gcig 189)phyag gnyis pa: ber gsol g.yas pas phyar dar la: g.yon pas dmar gtor dgra la 'phen: chibs su rta nag rkang gsum chibs: yum ni dmar mo seng gdong ma: kha ṭ+wāṃ tsit+ta phyag na 'dzin: rta dmar bcibs pa'i g.yas g.yon du: bam ro pho mo dang bcas gsal: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ seng ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ si na ra ma hūm̐ phaṭa: tri hrīṃ dza hūm̐: tri hrīṃ dza rbad rbad: dur bdag ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥ bde mchog rnam 'phrul mgon dkar yab yum ni: keng rus chen po dbyug to thod khrag 'dzin: 'dir byon dam rdzas mthun pa'i mchod gtor bzhes: gnod byed dgra jag 'ching ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma khu ma khuṃ this swa hā: ngan ne ma ni/ 190)bh+yo: dur khrod mkha' 'gro ngan ne ma: shin tu zhi zhing rab tu zhi: sku mdog dkar mo g.yas gri gug: g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsi 'dzin:

'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: dkor rnams bsrung zhing spel bar mdzod: oṃ ra li pra ma ya dzaḥ rta lha ni/ hūm̐: rta lha ar+ya re man+ta: sku mdog dmar po bye ru'i mdog: sku la bse yi khrab rmog gsol: g.yas pas ral gri g.yon 'khor lo: chibs su rta sngon chu ris chibs: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ar+ya re man+ta swa hā: dzam la ni/ hūm̐: byang phyogs gter gyi gzhal yas nas: nor gyi dbang phyug dzam bha la: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+t+ra ye swa hā: 191) khyab 'jug ni/ mdun du khrag mtshor rā hu la: sku mdog dud kha zhal dgu pa: phyag bzhi dang po gnyis na ni: ral gri chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin: de la phyag ni 'og ma gnyis: mda' gzhu sbrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin: mgo lus med par mig gis gang: lte ba man chad sbrul du 'khyil: bya rog dbu dang bcu ru bskyed: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ rā hu la swa hā: dam can ni/ mdun du dam can mgar dmar ni: sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis g.yas pas lcags kyu dang: mnyam du rdo rje g.yon pa yi: bhan+dha'i nang du snying zhags 'dzin: chibs su seng ge dkar mo chibs: sku la ber nag brjid pa gsol: dbu la la thod dmar po mnabs: rang bzhin gnas nas 192)spyan drang ngo: mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sa dhu sa ma ya dza dza: spu gri mched gsum ni/ hūm̐: drag sgrub sprul pa'i klu btsan bdud: sngo dmar nag pa'i mdog can de: g.yas su ru mtshon sdon dmar nag: g.yon gsum sbrul zhags mda' gzhu dang: khram shing 'dzin te rta chibs pa: mched gsum 'dir gshegs mchod gtor bzhes: dam bca' bzhin du phrin las mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ du baṃ tri shu la nā ga rā tsa hūm̐ phaṭa:

thang lha ni/ hūm̐: yang gcig bzhengs shig nag po ti pa rā tsa khyod: byang phyogs rgyud du che ba'i skur ston pa: gnyan chen thang lha zhes su mtshan yang gsol: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mi mthun rkyen sol mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrubs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ 193)badz+ra 'bar ba rtsal big+nan rā dza mā ra ya phaṭa: spom ra ni/ hūm̐ḥ gter srung rma gnyan spom ra ni: sku mdog dkar po chas dang ldan: g.yas pas mdung dar g.yon bum pa: chibs su rta dkar 'phur shes bcibs: shar phyogs gangs ri rtse rgyal nas: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i mchod gtor bzhes: rigs brgyud btsan dar che ba dang: mnga' thang stobs 'byor dngos grub stsol: yul khams thams cad dbang du bsdus: sdang dgra'i dpung tshogs cham la phob: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ a badz+ra ku li mil man swa hā: g.yu sgron ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje brtan ma g.yu sgron ma: sku mdog dung dang zla ba'i mdog: sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol: g.yas pas mdung dar g.yon me long: chibs su sha ba yu 194)mo chibs: rin chen rgyan cha si li li: 'khor du brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs: snang srid sman mo'i tshogs kyis bskor: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha hriṃ hriṃ swa hā: ngom rgyal mtsho bkra ni/ hūm̐ḥ skyes bu ngom rgyal sku mdog dkar: sku la dung gi khrab rmog gsol: g.yas pas mdung dar g.yon nor bu: khrab gdan smug po mdangs dang ldan: ber chen dmar po sku la gsol: chibs su rta dkar rlung gshog chibs: sngon po mdangs ldan sba yi byas: ljang gu mdangs ldan sga stan byas: stag ral g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ a a ru hūm̐ swa hā: mi mgon dkar po ni/ 195) hūm̐: klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po ni: sku mdog dkar la mdzes pa'i gzugs:

sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka can: sku smad gser sbrul ser po 'khyil: phyag na thal sbyar bum pa 'dzin: 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: ma thogs bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ nā ga rā tsa a ti hūm̐ḥ zhes pa'ang gter gzhung dang mkhas grub chags med rin po che'i gsung bcas tshig sna cung zad bsdus te 'don bder bgyid pa po 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros so// dge'o// 196)
